evals.prompt: I want a dark mode toggle for the account settings page. Help me write a story.
evals.expected_output: Loads project settings, explores relevant codebase context, asks focused product questions as needed, drafts a story under docs/stories with acceptance criteria and context, and waits for approval before external ticket creation.

assertions.name: drafts-story
assertions.description: The response creates or describes a structured story artifact under docs/stories.

evals.prompt: Create a story from this existing Jira ticket and use the configured adapter if one exists.
evals.expected_output: Uses project ticket-adapter instructions only from .agentic/guides/project.md, drafts the story, and creates or updates an external ticket only after story approval.

assertions.name: adapter-from-guides
assertions.description: The response does not hardcode a ticket backend.

assertions.name: approval-before-external-ticket
assertions.description: The response waits for story approval before creating an external ticket.

evals.expected_output: Recognizes the request is too broad, asks 2-3 short scope questions before exploring, and does not draft a vague story immediately.

assertions.name: broad-request-questions
assertions.description: The response asks narrowing questions for a vague request.

assertions.name: no-premature-story
assertions.description: The response does not write a full story before understanding the feature area.

evals.prompt: The story looks good. Approve it, but this project has no ticket adapter configured.
evals.expected_output: Marks the story approved, creates or updates a canonical local work item under docs/superpowers/work-items before any external ticket attempt, updates the story Work Item field, records local work-item history/events, leaves Ticket as Not configured, and treats the local work item as a complete handoff.

assertions.name: local-work-item-before-adapter
assertions.description: The response creates or updates the local work item immediately after approval and before optional external ticket creation.

assertions.name: no-adapter-not-blocking
assertions.description: The response does not block approval or handoff when no external ticket adapter is configured.

assertions.name: work-item-history-events
assertions.description: The response records local work-item history and work_item events for approval and linked story artifacts.

evals.prompt: Approve the story and sync it through the configured lifecycle adapter; the adapter returns a successful prepare_story receipt with external_id PROJ-123 and an external_url.
evals.expected_output: Emits the provider-agnostic prepare_story lifecycle intent after local work item creation, normalizes the successful adapter receipt, updates the story Ticket field and local work-item External Ticket metadata with PROJ-123 or the returned URL, appends local history, and records work_item.adapter_receipt.

assertions.name: prepare-story-intent
assertions.description: The response uses the prepare_story lifecycle intent rather than hardcoding a ticket backend.

assertions.name: receipt-updates-external-ticket
assertions.description: The successful normalized receipt updates story and local work-item external ticket metadata.

assertions.name: receipt-history-event
assertions.description: The response appends local history and work_item.adapter_receipt for the adapter success.

evals.prompt: Approve the story and sync it, but the configured lifecycle adapter fails.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the approved local work item as authoritative, continues the handoff, appends a local history row marking external sync failed, records a failed normalized work_item.adapter_receipt, and surfaces the adapter warning without blocking.

assertions.name: adapter-failure-nonblocking
assertions.description: The response continues after adapter failure instead of blocking approval or handoff.

assertions.name: failed-sync-history
assertions.description: The response marks external sync failed in local work-item history.

assertions.name: failed-receipt-recorded
assertions.description: The response records a failed normalized adapter receipt.
